capabilities: chat with streaming responses using selection, current note, or retrieved notes as context
retrieve relevant notes via keyword search and optional embedding-based semantic retrieval
explain, rewrite, or summarize text from the command palette
run a bounded agent mode with per-operation confirmation for note writes
connect to configurable OpenAI-compatible chat and embedding endpoints
extras: Desktop-only in its first public release; mobile support may come later. Feature availability depends on what the configured endpoint supports (streaming, tool calls, embeddings). Sends vault content to the configured provider; the author directs users to review that service's privacy terms.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an AI model using the vault's notes as context or to let an AI agent make verified note edits.
summary: AI assistant plugin that streams chat with vault notes as context and runs a confirmation-gated agent for note actions.
